title: Pathway
description: A general education course from a thematic sequence (a 'pathway') that the student builds across disciplines, outside the major.

title: Scientific Literacy and Inquiry 1
description: A natural science lecture course, such as biology, chemistry, physics, or geology, that introduces scientific reasoning and the field's main ideas.
notes: UB Science Sequence (7-9 credits with lab).

title: Scientific Literacy and Inquiry 2
description: A second natural science lecture course, continuing a science sequence.

title: Scientific Literacy and Inquiry Lab
description: A laboratory course that accompanies one of the student's science lectures.
notes: UB Science Sequence: one credit of lab in the same subject as a lecture.

title: Probability/Statistics Course
description: A calculus-based course in probability and statistics: random variables, distributions, expectation, estimation, and hypothesis testing.
notes: Choice slot: UB's EAS 305, EE 305, CE 305, or CIE 308.

title: Topic Area 1 (Theory)
description: An upper-level theory course, such as theory of computation, advanced algorithms, randomized algorithms, quantum computation, or coding theory.

title: Topic Area 2 (Security)
description: An upper-level computer security course: systems, software, or network security and system administration.

title: Topic Area 3 (Artificial Intelligence)
description: An upper-level artificial intelligence course, such as AI, machine learning, computer vision, natural language processing, robotics, or data mining.

title: CSE 300 or 400 Technical Elective
description: An upper-level computer science course chosen by the student.
notes: UB: one general 300- or 400-level CSE course.

title: Specialization 1
description: An upper-level computer science course in the student's chosen specialization area.
notes: UB: two courses from one Topic Area.

title: Specialization 2
description: A second upper-level computer science course in the student's specialization area.
notes: UB: two courses from one Topic Area.

title: Math or Science Elective
description: An additional mathematics or natural science course chosen from an approved list.
notes: UB: one additional math or science course.

title: Capstone Requirement
description: A senior capstone course in which students apply their computing knowledge to a substantial project, such as a team software engineering project, a compiler, or research.
notes: Choice slot: UB's CSE 402, CSE 442, CSE 443, or CSE 494. Official descriptions are in data/raw/ub/courses/.

title: Elective
description: Any course the student chooses that counts toward the degree, inside or outside the major.

title: UB Curriculum Capstone
description: A short capstone for the general education program, in which students reflect on and connect their general education coursework, often through an e-portfolio.
notes: UB: UBC 399 (1 credit). The official description is in data/raw/ub/courses/ (UBC399M entry).
